editorial:
Imagine a group of friends who take their hobbies way too far. You get a wild mix of laughs and scares as these guys try to pull off something totally crazy. The vibe feels like a late-night hangout that goes south quickly, mixing awkward comedy with some creepy moments that keep you guessing. It is a weird ride, but the chemistry between the characters makes you care about what happens to them, even when they are making the worst decisions possible.

You will love how the tension builds up before everything explodes into chaos. The acting feels natural, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. If you like movies where a funny situation turns into a nightmare, you should definitely check this out. It is the perfect choice for a weekend movie night with friends who love odd indie films.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the group realizes they are not as in control as they thought. The big twist reveals that one of the members was playing a double game the whole time. In the final scenes, the horror elements take over, and most of the group fails to escape the mess they created. It ends on a dark note, showing that their obsession finally caught up with them in the worst way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird comedies that turn into horror movies.
